Missing required capabilities or failed/unknown portable IDs SHALL fail.

A versioned finite capability/selection manifest SHALL cover every discovered test ID. No old g qualification receipt SHALL become current selected authority. Fixture contract success SHALL NOT substitute for current selected raw-model/container/native/cold paired evidence or full campaign acceptance.

Canonical interpreter launch, explicit fixed repository imports and actual GStreamer runtime factory prerequisites SHALL preserve original isolation, test identifiers, capture/deadline and native predicates. Sibling inventory renewal SHALL invalidate its affected runtime image authorities without delaying the separately authorized selected pair.
